items.description: Only the first 1000 entries are considered.

reset_progress.description: Defaults to false. When true, copy without dates, assignees or checklist progress.

name.description: Trimmed name of 1 to 100 characters, unique in the list.

options.description: Required for `select` and `multi_select`. These fields allow 1 to 50 distinct options.

sort_order.description: A field without an explicit order goes last.

description.description: Defaults to an empty description. Trimmed to at most 1000 characters.

content_type.description: Defaults to `application/octet-stream` if null, blank or omitted.

filename.description: Trimmed filename, up to 255 characters. An empty or omitted value becomes `unnamed`.

size_bytes.description: Exact number of bytes. The legacy API also accepts an integer string.

value.description: Stored string. Multi-select values contain a JSON-encoded string array.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone. Missing and unknown values use Asia/Seoul.

IdentityErrorResponse.description: Error produced by the SDK gateway's signed-identity check.

oneOf.description: A decimal integer string. Leading and trailing whitespace is ignored.

due_date.description: Must be on or after start_date when both are present.

oneOf.description: Omit or send null to append after the current last milestone.

due_date.description: Omit to keep this date; null clears it.

start_date.description: Omit to keep this date; null clears it.

SavedFilterCreateRequest.description: Specify exactly one of list_id and space_id.

params.description: The normalized filter is at most 8 KiB of JSON.

SavedFilterDefaultRequest.description: Specify exactly one of list_id and space_id.

filter_id.description: Omit or send null to clear the current default.

custom_fields.description: Up to 50 custom field IDs mapped to their conditions.

q.description: Accepted for compatibility and never persisted.

field.description: A task sort key or cf_<custom field ID>.

oneOf.description: Omit to keep the current group, or send null to clear it.
Omit to keep the current sort, or send null to clear it.

limit.description: Defaults to 10. Values outside 1 through 10 are clamped.

query.description: Matches task titles and references. Use 1 to 200 characters after trimming.

value.description: An empty or omitted value clears the field. Multi-select values use a JSON-encoded string array.

email.description: The platform does not provide an email address here.

is_admin.description: Administrative access is represented by the app space role.

oneOf.description: Hiding a space unpins it. Use null to leave this field unchanged.
Pinning a space unhides it. Use null to leave this field unchanged.

email.description: The platform directory does not provide an email address.

linked_docs.description: Currently empty. The task detail does not populate linked documents.

key.description: Omit to generate a key from the name.

oneOf.description: Non-negative order. Omission or null uses zero.

folder_id.description: Omit to keep the folder, or send null to move to the space root.

parent_id.description: Omit to keep the current parent. Use null to move the task to the top level.

description_blocks.description: Omit to keep the existing blocks, or send null to clear them.

expected_options.description: The complete option list read before editing, in order.

name.description: Trimmed name of 1 to 100 characters, unique in the list.

options.description: New select options. Supply `expected_options` in the same request.

description.description: Omit or send null to keep the description. Trimmed to at most 1000 characters.

name.description: Omit or send null to keep the name. Trimmed to 2 through 120 characters.
